jobs.description:
Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowloedge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse worker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in warehouse work or logistics? And are you looking for a stable employer with a lot of job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team in the night shift. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse operator, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electrical pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in warehouse work or logistics
• Can operate an electrical pallet truck (EPT) with ease
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Specifically want to work in night shift
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

!! If you don't meet every requirement but have some warehouse experience and a strong work ethic, you can still apply !!

 

IMPORTANT: this job is only available for people who:

• Already live in Belgium
• Have a valid Belgian address
• Have legal permission to work in Belgium
Housing, relocation and visa sponsorship are not available for this position.

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

Looking for a new challenge in supply chain within an international and forward-thinking organization?

As a Supply Chain Assistant you will support the supply chain team with daily tasks such as:

• Manage material availability and inventory levels to ensure uninterrupted operations. 
• Maintain SAP MRP parameters and follow up on shortages, replenishmen, and planning activities. 
• Coordinate with Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering and Operations teams to resolve material-related issues. 
• Analyze KPIs and SAP reports to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
• Support process improvement and optimization initiatives for critical materials and supply chain workflows.

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Good knowledge of SAP, MRP planning and inventory management processes.
• Strong Excel and data analysis skills.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills with a proactive and results-oriented mindset.

As a maintenance mechanic for trucks, you are responsible for the technical maintenance of trailers. You make sure that everything is ready for inspection and carry out interventions where needed. You replace brakes, shock absorbers and other worn parts. Welding work on trailers is also part of your job.

On a typical day, you start by checking trailers scheduled for inspection. You perform planned maintenance and repair defective parts. You assemble and disassemble components, work independently on repairs and coordinate with colleagues when necessary. If you have knowledge of hydraulics or electricity, that's a plus, but not a must. Communication with colleagues and, if needed, customers is in Dutch, French, English or German.

Do you like to get hands-on and make sure everything is in top technical condition? Are you solution-oriented and prefer to work independently? Apply now and take the first step toward this job!

jobs.occupation: Operations Coordinator - Dutch & German speaking m/f/d (Callcenteragent/in)
jobs.description:
**Location:**  Ghent

Client confidential

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future? If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. 

This is us, your new colleagues

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.

This is the job

- Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind.
- Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress.
- A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box.
- Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business 

Are you the one?

- You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers.
- You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported.
- You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset.
- You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up.
- You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills.
- You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients.
- You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German.

A perfect match? Just some of the benefits working for us...

- Competitive salary, with meal vouchers, transport costs, shift allowance, etc.
- Well-being services
- Restaurant on site
- Opportunity to grow within the company
- Good work life balance
- International environment
- Support in relocation when moving from abroad

We are looking for packing employees who are available to work in a three-shift system (food industry) in Dendermonde?

If you're interested, read the job description and apply!

You will be working in the packing department of a company that specializes in packaging frozen products. This role involves working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 10°C).

Your main tasks include:

• Checking product quality

• Packing various products (such as fish, snacks, vegetables, etc.) into boxes or bags

• Applying labels

• Stacking boxes on pallets

• Maintaining close communication with the operator

• Other related tasks

What we expect from you:

• You have previous experience in a production environment or are willing to learn, and you can work flexibly in a three-shift system (morning, late and night shift).

• You are comfortable performing physical work at a steady pace.

• You have a good command of Dutch or English to understand safety instructions.

• You can travel independently to Dendermonde each day, as the company is located in an industrial zone and is not accessible by public transport.

• You are looking for long-term employment and are willing to complete a 2-hour packing test after a successful interview.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

Our client is a leading player in the events industry, specialising in the design and manufacture of exhibition stand systems. The company is renowned for its innovative approach and high-quality products, which are used worldwide at trade fairs, exhibitions and events.

Let's Work is recruiting a production technician to work two shifts for an international market leader in Roeselare.

You will be responsible for providing technical support within an automated production environment, which includes CNC machines, robots, milling machines and sawing machines. In the event of malfunctions, you will analyse and resolve the problem as efficiently as possible, whilst also carrying out preventive maintenance and making improvements to the machinery. You'll receive an attractive salary supplemented by meal vouchers, thorough training and ongoing support within a modern working environment where safety, wellbeing and teamwork are key.

Do you get a kick out of tackling technical faults quickly and do you enjoy working with a varied and automated range of machinery? Then be sure to read on!

What will your tasks involve?

 
• 
You will identify, analyse and pragmatically resolve technical faults in the machinery so that production can resume quickly

 
• 
Following technical interventions, you document the work carried out and the solutions implemented

 
• 
You carry out preventive maintenance in accordance with the existing maintenance plan

 
• 
Together with the Technical Manager, you'll develop ideas for improvements and ensure their practical implementation

 
• 
Within the machinery fleet, you'll work with CNC machines, milling and sawing machines, handling and pick & place robots, and welding robots

 
• 
When technical problems arise, you take independent responsibility and actively seek a workable solution

 
• 
A technical qualification with prior experience in electromechanics forms the basis for this role

 
• 
Experience within an industrial production environment is important, preferably with CNC, robots, fully automated production lines and machine maintenance

 
• 
Knowledge of motors and gearboxes, compressed air, hydraulics, electricity and HMI is very useful

 
• 
Experience with welding is essential; a VCA certificate and a forklift or aerial work platform licence are an advantage

 
• 
Fluency in English is important for internal communication on the shop floor. You should also be comfortable using basic PC applications

 
• 
You are hands-on, independent, keen to learn and results-oriented and attach great importance to 5S and the safe handling of valuable equipment

• You analyze finance and controlling processes and translate business requirements into functional SAP solutions 

• You configure and optimize SAP FICO processes and contribute to the development of a standardized SAP template 

• You actively participate in blueprint, fit-gap, and implementation projects 

• You prepare functional and technical specifications and follow them through testing and go-live 

• You support the business during user acceptance testing and post-implementation support 

• You collaborate with business process owners, key users, and IT colleagues 

• You contribute to third-line support and the continuous improvement of the SAP landscape 

• You work with modern SAP technologies, including SAP S/4HANA 

• ... 
 

• You hold a master’s or bachelor’s degree 

• You have at least 2 years of experience as a SAP FICO Consultant or SAP Business Analyst 

• You have a thorough knowledge of Finance and Controlling processes within SAP 

• Experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment is a plus 

• You are analytical, structured, and solution-oriented 

• You are able to work independently but also function effectively within a team 

• You are willing to travel occasionally within Europe 

• You communicate fluently in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a plus

jobs.occupation: Become a Wheel Loader or Forklift Operator for a Recycling Company – Environmentally Conscious Job i
jobs.description:
Are you skilled with a wheel loader or forklift and looking for a varied job in the recycling sector? This position as a wheel loader/forklift operator is perfect for you. You’ll help recycle plastic waste and contribute to a better environment. Your main tasks include moving plastic waste, handling big bags, and safely loading and unloading trucks.

On a typical workday, you’ll start with a short briefing before you begin moving waste streams around the site. You work accurately and ensure everything ends up in the right place. Sometimes the waste can have an odor, but thanks to your dedication, the site stays orderly and safe. You’ll follow a unique work schedule: 4 weeks working in Lanaken, followed by 4 weeks off at home in Poland.

Do you have a valid certificate and speak English or Polish? Apply now! You’ll receive a great salary, meal vouchers, and the possibility to extend your contract. We’re looking for motivated people who want to help build a more sustainable world.

• Possession of a forklift operator or wheel loader operator certificate

• Good command of English or Polish, both spoken and written

• Minimum diploma of higher secondary education

• Experience operating a wheel loader, forklift, or crane is a plus

• Flexibility to work in a 4-weeks-on, 4-weeks-off system

• Safety minded and orderly work habits

• Open to junior, medior, and senior candidates

Our client is a logistics trading company based in Breda.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you combine operational, commercial, and coordinating responsibilities within international ocean freight. You manage the full transport process from A to Z and act as the key link between internal teams and external partners. In addition, you lead a team and ensure structure, overview, and continuous process optimization.

The position is based in Breda, so you are willing to commute to this location on a daily basis.

Your Responsibilities
	
• Coordinate international deep-sea shipments (cross-trade)	
• Maintain contact and negotiate with shipping lines, forwarders, and suppliers	
• Book and follow up shipments until delivery	
• Manage and verify export documentation (B/Ls, L/Cs, Incoterms)	
• Analyze rates and optimize transport flows	
• Report to purchasing and sales teams	
• Lead and support a team (5 FTE)	
• Contribute to and implement improvements in operational processes

Your Profile
	
• 3 to 5 years of experience as a freight forwarder (deep sea), ready for the next step	
• Strong operational and commercial mindset	
• Experience with international transport within a trading environment is a plus	
• Good command of English (required); additional languages are an asset (Dutch not required)	
• Proactive, assertive, and strong communicator	
• Able to build relationships and identify opportunities	
• Strong organizational skills and sense of responsibility	
• Flexible mindset (willing to commute to Breda; international environment with multiple time zones)

jobs.occupation: Become a Truck Mechanic – Join a Dynamic Team in Belgium!
jobs.description:
As a truck mechanic, you are key to ensuring our fleet runs smoothly. You carry out thorough diagnostics, repairs, and maintenance on DAF trucks. You view electrical issues as challenges and are comfortable reading electrical wiring diagrams. You test wiring harnesses, electrical systems, and control units, and communicate clearly with customers and manufacturers about the work performed.

A typical day starts with a team meeting. Then, you work independently or with colleagues in our fully equipped workshop. You use the latest diagnostic equipment, keep up with the newest technical updates from the manufacturer, and coordinate with other mechanics when needed. Additionally, you provide technical support to our branch in Herent.

Are you looking for a technical role with variety, autonomy, and responsibility? Apply now and grow with our ambitious team!

• You have a high school diploma (A3/A2) in automotive mechanics or equivalent through experience.

• A professional or academic bachelor’s degree in automotive technology is a plus.

• You have at least 2 years of relevant experience in the automotive sector.

• Basic knowledge of electronics is required.

• You speak and understand Dutch fluently; knowledge of English is an asset.

• You are motivated, practical, and able to work independently.

• Leadership skills are a plus.

• A C(E) driver's license is an advantage but not required.

  • Maintenance and repair of high-voltage installations;
  • Identifying and resolving malfunctions;
  • Correct administrative processing of interventions;
  • Performing inspections and troubleshooting;
  • Testing and commissioning electrical systems;
  • Collaborating with engineers and project teams for innovative solutions.
Our client in Ostend is looking for a new High Voltage Technician with the following qualities:

  • Technical background with experience in medium/high-voltage installations or a strong interest in the field;
  • BA5 certification and strong awareness of safety regulations;
  • You speak DUTCH or GOOD ENGLISH;
  • Eager to learn and motivated to grow into an independent role.
